note: Route-graph ratchet baseline (no-new-rot ratchet). Each entry is the CURRENT reachable-first-party-module-count ceiling for a LOCKED FIXED_ROUTES route (the primary dev-perf 'first-party graph pressure' metric from scripts/route-graph.mjs). The gate fails when a tracked route's count grows BEYOND its ceiling and when the committed baseline raises any ceiling vs the base branch WITHOUT a matching absorb record. Counts are captured WITH the companion extension repos cloned pinned (exactly as CI does via clone-extensions) so they reproduce in CI. Regenerate with `node scripts/audit/route-graph-ratchet.mjs --write-baseline` after cloning the extensions — a ceiling should only ever be LOWERED as barrel imports are narrowed, and is never raised SILENTLY. A sanctioned raise must be ANNOTATED: a sibling `absorbs` record `route -> { from, to, reason, pr }` whose from/to exactly match the raise vs the base branch (from = the base ceiling, to = the new committed ceiling, reason = why the growth is accepted, pr = the PR carrying the absorbed change). The gate validates records strictly (malformed/stale/orphan records fail closed; a carried-forward record may not be deleted while its raised ceiling is kept) and prints a LOUD NOTICE line for every absorbed raise. The tracked route set is route-graph.mjs FIXED_ROUTES; change it there, then regenerate.

/api/a2a.reason: cinatra#2683 (epic #2564 S8f), on top of the post-#2577 base ceiling (itself rebased onto the post-#2689 main, so every absolute number below moves with the base while the measured DELTA does not). TWO raises land in this PR and this record covers both, replacing the carried #2577 record on the same route. (1) THE ONE CONVERSATION COLUMN (commit c757fa395, +2 on /chat only): /chat's column moved out of chat-page.tsx into packages/chat/src/conversation-column.tsx so the widget mounts the SAME component, and the column needs packages/chat/src/app-route-link.tsx for its link policy. (2) THE WIDGET'S OWN CREDENTIAL (commit b274683aa): each cookie-bound composer data path gained a widget auth BRANCH built on ONE door (src/lib/widget-conversation-door.ts + -branch + -grants), and the parked-call and undo implementations moved OUT of their cookie-bound server actions into principal-taking surfaces (src/lib/chat/pending-tool-call-surface.ts, src/lib/chat/undo-candidate-surface.ts) that the action and the route now both call — one implementation behind two credentials, which is the whole point of the slice and is what makes the modules reachable from more than one entry. MEASURED, not estimated: base ea2ccbbca -> head, same environment, same cloned extensions — /chat +5 (app src +3, @cinatra-ai/chat +2), /api/mcp +1, /api/a2a +1, /api/llm-bridge +1, /sign-in unchanged at 218. THE WAVE THAT WRITES THIS RECORD ADDS ZERO: the four proof commits (the /chat scripted lifecycle branch, the "use server" type-re-export fix, the @-mention directory's route-guard entry) were measured with and without — identical counts — so every module here belongs to the two feature commits above and this file is only catching up with them. NARROWING CONSIDERED AND REJECTED: collapsing the door back into each route would remove the one place the widget branch is decided and let six routes drift apart on authentication, which is the defect the slice exists to prevent; and keeping the parked-call/undo logic inside the server actions is what made them unreachable to the widget in the first place.
